subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the official Google Chat plugin add all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, Space-filtering, and subscription lifecycle contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review proves the gap, but receiving non-mentioned Space messages broadens data visibility and credential handling beyond the current service-account webhook boundary, so automation should not choose the product/security model.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define SecretRef-backed credentials, scopes, consent/admin approval, Space filtering, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhooks Only
options.body: Leave the Google Chat plugin on the current service-account interaction-event model and treat all-message ingestion as unsupported for now.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a broader Google Workspace credential and event-subscription model before adding a Google Chat-specific implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define SecretRef-backed credentials, scopes, consent/admin approval, Space filtering, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from recent review and Google Chat threading/webhook history.
